lead: An XRPL wallet needs a base reserve plus applicable owner reserves, separately from the money it intends to send.
results.conclusion: An XRPL wallet needs a base reserve plus applicable owner reserves, separately from the money it intends to send. Base reserve supports the account's existence; owner reserve constrains ledger objects. Removing an object can release its reserve requirement.
